All objectives verified on a fresh page load. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE**: The provisioned dashboard `Service health` contains 3 panels, titled exactly:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE**: New dashboard `fwgr-n1 Bench Dashboard` created and saved, containing a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr-n1 Availability` whose query uses the **TestData** data source (grafana-testdata-datasource). Verified by opening the panel in edit mode after a fresh reload; the Stat panel rendered a value of 50.5.

**Objective 3 — DONE**: The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr-n1 Notes` with content "Bench notes for run fwgr-n1" (plus sub-items "Started: now" and "Status: monitoring") — the runid is included. Saved and confirmed on reload.

**Objective 4 — DONE**: The dashboard has the tag `bench` (confirmed in Dashboard settings → General → Tags) and its time range is `Last 6 hours` (time picker button reads "Time range selected: Last 6 hours"). Saved with "Update default time range" checked.

**Objective 5 — DONE**: Auto-refresh interval is `1m` (refresh picker shows "current interval 1 minute selected"; URL carries `refresh=1m`). Saved with "Update default refresh value" checked.

**Objective 6 — DONE**: Dashboard URL: `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfwchplb17x1cb/fwgr-n1-bench-dashboard` — UID: `cfwchplb17x1cb`.

All saves were confirmed via the "Dashboard saved" alert and the absence of any unsaved-changes indicator, and every value above was re-verified after a hard fresh page load of the dashboard.
